message: In the twin-rack cold room enclosure (C4), the separate shade canopy support for the upsized array has overload risk, Maya. To check it I used panel area division and post load estimate (the Photovoltaic area estimate (E24)). I found 20.3 square metres for 4 kilowatts at 200 watts per square metre, according to Trina Solar datasheet, 2024. I propose separate galvanised steel canopy on four anchored posts with vented gap above 100 millimetre Polyurethane (Polyurethane (PU), closed-cell foam insulation) panels, not bearing on panels. My position: not ready because cloudy refill sizing still needs your electrical sign-off. In the 100 millimetre Polyurethane insulated enclosure (C4), the canopy post footing plus ice-bank floor load has bearing problem, Sam. To check it I used footing load division (the canopy post-load estimate (E25)). I found 75 kilograms per post for 220 kilograms panels plus 80 kilograms frame, according to Longi panel datasheet, 2024. I propose ground-anchored footings plus reinforced floor plinth for 100 kilograms ice under evaporator carrying night load. My position: not ready because system autonomy closure by others is still open.
